note: Owner decisions and deviations the Rehearsal 5 kickoff depends on, with their current status. The preflight (--kickoff-decisions) blocks PRE-DEC-01 on every entry whose status is not decided, accepted, approved, resolved or after-ready-preflight; an entry with coveredBy is checked by the preflight check it names.

operatorAuthorization.detail: Not given. The operator authorizes Rehearsal 5 only after a READY preflight, so this is not a preflight condition.

operatorApprovals.detail: After the T07 derivation in the Rehearsal 5 repository, the operator writes the approvals (causa.requirements-approvals/1 for the verifier, praxis.requirements-approvals/1 for the gate) and the equivalence reviews (T09). Agents must not write or transcribe them (RDP-003, OD-INDY-7). Rehearsal 4 deviated twice; remediation OD-3 (ratify or replace those transcriptions) is open.

scope.detail: OD-INDY-11 excluded T27 and T28 (AI proposal loop, time travel) from Rehearsal 4 only. Whether Rehearsal 5 keeps that exclusion is the owner's decision; until decided, Rehearsal 5 runs the full baseline.

dependencyDeviations.subject: @echelon-foundry/forma-workflow 1.0.0 is used but is not in the Echelon Registry
dependencyDeviations.detail: Owner-approved for Rehearsal 4 only. Carry-over to Rehearsal 5 needs the owner: remediation OD-6 asks whether to publish forma-workflow in the Registry or keep R4-DEC-001.

dependencyDeviations.subject: The authoritative acceptance verifier (tools/compute-acceptance-verdict.py) is Python
dependencyDeviations.detail: the owner's authoritative tool; it is run, never reimplemented; not part of the application or its build

resolvedSinceRehearsal4.subject: Conditor 0.10.13 (bootstrap tool) was not in the Registry
resolvedSinceRehearsal4.resolution: release record added and REG-RU-007 re-run against it on the 1.28.0 channel (kemiller2002/echelon-registry#99)

verification.subject: Percepta screen contracts cannot run against Causa
verification.detail: percepta-semantic 0.2.1 verifies only a local file committed at the source revision, not a served or deployed site; Causa has no state-injection hook and one data-percepta hook; the 25 contracts are generic example screens. A Causa contract set and a test-only state hook need the owner (the OD-1 waiver covers the Rehearsal 4 baseline only).
